typeProperties.script:
parameters{

}

		entryDate as timestamp,
		riskMonth_Dte as date,
		riskDate as timestamp,
		Record_Status as string,
		description as string,
		co as string,
		amtOrig as integer,
		subAccount as string,
		dr as integer,
		cr as integer,
		itemId as string,
		effDate as timestamp,
		Type as string,
		riskMonth as string,
		create_dt as timestamp,
		currency as string,
		balancePool as string,
		name1 as string,
		update_dte as timestamp,
		riskMonth_Adj_Dte as date
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> GetRecordsINT
GetRecordsINT sink(input(
		dda as string,
		amount as integer,
		AU_Number as string,
		entryDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		riskMonth_Dte as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		riskDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Record_Status as string,
		description as string,
		co as string,
		amtOrig as integer,
		subAccount as string,
		dr as integer,
		cr as integer,
		itemId as string,
		effDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Type as string,
		riskMonth as string,
		create_dt as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		currency as string,
		balancePool as string,
		name1 as string,
		update_dte as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		riskMonth_Adj_Dte as date 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,batchSize: 10000,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		dda,
		amount,
		AU_Number,
		entryDate,
		riskMonth_Dte,
		riskDate,
		Record_Status,
		description,
		co,
		amtOrig,
		subAccount,
		dr,
		cr,
		itemId,
		effDate,
		Type,
		riskMonth,
		create_dt,
		currency,
		balancePool,
		name1,
		update_dte,
		riskMonth_Adj_Dte),
	partitionFileNames:[($LoadrecordsEOMINT_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> LoadrecordsEOMINT
